ITEM 1 | Roasted orange-fleshed squash wedges with dark green skin edges, four pieces with browned, slightly caramelized surfaces and a firm, dense, moist cut face; largest wedge about 5 cm long and 2.5 cm thick, arranged in an arc on the left side of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Finely shredded dark green kale with ruffled, curly leaf edges and a slightly glossy, dressed sheen, mounded in a loose pile covering roughly a quarter of the plate on the right side; a few pale, thin shaved cheese shards lie on and among the leaves | 120
ITEM 3 | Thin, pale cream-yellow shaved cheese shards, flat and slightly translucent with a dry edge, scattered on top of and beside the kale, each about 2 to 3 cm long | 8
ITEM 4 | Small scattered green kale leaf fragments and stems lying flat on the plate near the squash, dark green and matte | 4
